doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: The River Bell
summary: They worked the River Bell with Mealy and George Henry, and a white band later replaced them.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: You ever work at the River Bell?
Yeah, the River Bell, I said the River Bell. He had the River Bell, yeah that's right. That's the River Bell, that's right.
Wasn't George Henry with us at the River Bell?
Yeah George, he used to talk about the trains, you know. George, myself, Dee Dee and Mealy. That's what I thought, yeah. The River Bell, yeah.
Y'all have worked a lot of places. Oh yeah.
And very seldom we, everybody like the way we wipe down. They just like to get work holes quite nice, just want white bands in there, well that's all the children do.
But Lawrence, I mean, uh, Gentile and, not Gentile, I was working out there last with Mealy the Harmonade, you and that man got so they couldn't get along. That's where he was. That Moss. Moss.
